### Compliance Statement

**Anti-Lazy Directive:** Every function will be fully implemented with no placeholder syntax (`// ... rest of the function`, `// ... insert logic here`). All physics, collision detection, input handling, and VFX systems will be complete, production-ready code. No stubs, no TODOs, no incomplete implementations.

**Strict Memory Management:** All Three.js objects (geometries, materials, textures, buffers) will have explicit `.dispose()` calls in cleanup routines. Object pooling will be enforced for all projectiles, entities, and particles. The Particle Manager enforces a hard cap of 500 active particles at any time via a centralized manager that evicts oldest particles when the limit is reached.

**Sequential Output Protocol:** I am outputting only this step's content (directory structure + compliance statement). No files are being created or commands run. I await your command to proceed to STEP 2.
